title: Hyperliquid says ex-employee responsible for HYPE token shorting
summary: Hyperliquid said that the wallet flagged by its community for insider HYPE shorting belongs to a former employee dismissed in early 2024.

title: Metaplanet clears issuance of dividend-paying shares for overseas institutions
summary: Japan’s largest corporate Bitcoin holder approved preferred shares with dividends, signaling a shift toward income-focused institutional capital.

title: Tether-backed Northern Data sold mining firm to Tether execs: FT
summary: Northern Data, which is majority-owned by Tether, sold its Bitcoin mining arm to businesses owned by Tether executives, the Financial Times reports.

title: US lawmakers push to fix staking ‘double taxation’ before 2026
summary: Lawmakers led by Republican Mike Carey argue that current IRS rules penalize stakers with an administrative burden and potentially over-tax unrealized gains.

title: Video game mods are spreading new ‘Stealka’ crypto infostealer: Kaspersky
summary: Kaspersky found a new malware, dubbed Stealka, that disguises itself as game mods and pirated software to steal crypto wallets, passwords, and browser data.

title: Fed seeks input on account type attractive to crypto firms
summary: The Federal Reserve is seeking public feedback on a new “payment account” that could give fintechs and crypto companies easier access to the central bank’s systems.

title: Fintechs’ prediction market addons will cost them in churn: Inversion CEO
summary: Inversion Capital CEO Santiago Roel Santos argued that “casino-like” features increase user liquidation risk, undermining long-term value capture.

title: Uniswap fee switch to go live as community vote set to pass
summary: Uniswap’s fee switch proposal, designed to boost its token’s supply-demand dynamics via token burns, has passed a community vote threshold and is set to take effect this week.

summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Tokenization will disrupt finance faster than digital disrupted media: Crypto exec
summary: Putting real-world assets onchain opens up new markets, increases capital velocity and democratizes access to finance, advocates say.
